stamped reject on "spec": 1. The spec breaks the standard's Lifecycle storage rule (STANDARD.md line 47: $.store is across sessions and read once per session; data shared live between sessions belongs in a file under $.plugin.root). The trial's runs are shared live between sessions but are kept only in the store key 'trial' ('No files'). In the real engine a session's store is cached at its start, so the 'read the store's trial again' step in State and storage returns this session's own stale copy: it never sees a run another open session wrote, nor another session's clear. The following $.store.set of the whole 'trial' value then wipes the other session's run and brings a cleared trial back. A7 (another session's later run survives this session's next write and shows in the totals; a trial ended elsewhere stops the writing and empties the card) and the Off section's rejoin cannot hold outside the kit's map-backed store. Right looks like: the trial (subject and runs) lives in one file under $.plugin.root, read and written with $.fs at join, after each counted turn, at test and at clear, named in Data and in State and storage, with the store holding only isOn; A2, A7, A10 and A11 and the Demo stand-in and Live expectation reworded to the file. Everything else passed review; do not redesign the rest.
